Name: boundary-wall
Description: Boundary wall: 400x200 columns with standard grill panels between them. Values from the AI-TEKLA project brief - confirm against the project standard before production use.
Notes: Gap applies at every panel end: column-panel and panel-panel.
Column width along the wall is 400 mm (column set with its 400 side along the wall). Change ColumnWidthAlongWallMm if the column is turned.
MinPanelLengthMm (300) is an assumption - set it to the shortest grill your workshop accepts.
